synthesizedFacts.fact: Skin type is largely determined by the amount of sebum (oil) your skin produces, which can be influenced by genetics, age, hormones, and environmental factors.
Combination skin is characterized by oiliness in the T-zone (forehead, nose, and chin) and dryness in other areas.
Dry skin can be exacerbated by environmental factors such as weather, UV radiation, and indoor heating.
Oily skin can lead to enlarged pores and is often influenced by hormonal changes and stress.
